notes.title: Release Version 0.19: Lighting and Tutorial
notes.content:
🚀 Release 0.19
🆕 New Content

Base building expanded with ladders, floors, walls, and metal doors.

Placeable wall clocks, new 2m tall door, and town terrace added.

New items: pickaxe, metal hammer, wooden hammer, bear trap, charcoal, sticks, decorative plants, leaves, coal icon.

Crafting: bandages from cloth scrap, biomass from leaves, handcrafting vs. workbench recipes split, more recipe tooltips.

Tutorial quests added: collect iron plates/rods, recycling, weapon crafting, farming (bak choi), showering, drinking water, and more.

New quest types: conquer territory, fertilize crops, hire help for squad.

Jail area expanded with towers, reception, showers, props, openable cell doors, and warden NPC.

🎨 Visuals and World

New Altos sky system with stars, cloud exposure, and better noir skies.

Added volumetric fog, dust storms, subtle god rays, and auto exposure.

Switched to ACES color grading, added HBAO for sharper edges, and Radiant GI.

MicroSplat terrain system with global texturing, glitter, wind, and blending.

Cars improved: faster, road-only, capped at 50 spawns.

Terrain fixes, new curved road system, 1km more connected highways, bridges, and darker sidewalks.

Jail area colliders optimized; RoundHut interior, Cafe building, and props improved.

Yurt Village now has angels for a cultish atmosphere.

🖥 UI and UX

Inventory screen updated: wider crafting UIs, new crafting category tabs, arms slot for wearables, player name/level shown.

Character shown in inventory with better scaling, symmetry, and blurred backgrounds.

Tooltips improved: clearer recipe values, more recipes shown at once, bigger rejection messages.

Hotbar: bigger outlines, darker crouch indicator, rounder skill icons, shinier progress fill.

Health bars redesigned: larger, genre-consistent, medical bars added.

Map view shows terrain and zooms; area view UI now fades in/out.

Loading screens polished: blur, brighter background, clearer “Loading” text.

Options: taller factions screen, gamma slider, cursor fixes, round toggles.

🐞 Fixes and Improvements

Numerous null refs fixed across UI, bushes, factions, and quests.

Bullet decals scaled properly.

Coffee machine/mugs collectible fix carried over.

Grappling hook no longer attaches to terrain.

Player now resets if save file corrupts.

Player can’t use skills while dead; no ammo hint hidden.

Cars no longer tick excessively and stick to roads.

Ragdolls simplified to Unity ragdolls; UMA expressions removed until stable.

Survival/UI polish: needs icons white, better blur, cleaner shadows, intro cutscene only once.

notes.title: Release Version 0.18
notes.content:
🚀 Release 0.18


🆕 New Content

Wearables expanded: sombrero, cyber mask, propeller hat, conical hat, explorer hat, and various faction hats.

New items: bowls, plates, pretzel chair, hotdog, onigiri, soy drink, mugs, empty bottles, recycling machine, coffee machine.

Collectable food: kielbasa, soy food, coffee mugs, rat meat.

World expansion with Yurt Village, crater area, RedCanyon planning, Old Town district, and a 2km highway dividing the map.

New environment props: propaganda screens, wooden planks/palettes, beds, geodesic dome, flags with cloth physics.

🎨 Visuals and World

Updated lighting: yellower sky, bleaker colors, stronger split toning, less bloom and blur for a noir style.

Market, vending machines, and fuel station improved; new metallic mug and houseplants.

Steam capsule made more dreadful with new logo, eye icon, and text fixes.

Terrain fixes, new paths, lighter ground colors, and improved modular architecture organization.

🖥 UI and UX

Inventory reduced from 40 → 36 → 32 slots for added survival pressure.

Map view now allows zooming and panning, with a placeholder world map added.

Clearer tooltips: illegal/recyclable tags, market values, reject hints.

Character creation UI polished: faction descriptions, better materials, reduced zoom, cleaner buttons.

Options menu improvements: darker backgrounds, gamma slider, better contrast, rounder toggles.

Calendar and tutorial UI improved for clarity and visibility.

Hotbar shows hotkeys, skill progress circles rounder, curfew and faction icons cleaner.

🐞 Fixes and Improvements

Numerous null reference errors fixed across UI, prefab uses, and props.

Fixed ragdoll blending glitches, missing materials, projectile visuals, and dead robot skins.

Coffee machine logic corrected; mugs now properly collectible.

Rats now drop rat meat (not computers).

Survival needs tick down slower to ease pacing.

Several unused assets, old prefabs, duplicate logs, and post-processing effects removed for performance and clarity.

notes.title: Release Version 0.17
notes.content:
🚀 Release 0.17
🆕 New Content

Electricity with generators, solar panels, wind turbines and sockets.

Started working on wearables like hats, cat ears and wigs.

New tools: pipe wrench, fire axe, halligan bar, chainsaw.

Tesla coil and railgun turret as new defenses.

🎨 Visuals and World

Larger sky dome with better lighting, fog and shadows.

Character creation polished with clearer text and more environment clutter.

New props added: graffiti, posters, coffee machine, paintings.

Simplified materials and post processing for cleaner visuals.

🖥 UI and UX

Inventory cut from 40 to 36 slots for more survival pressure.

Illegal items now marked in tooltips.

Computer calendar shows day and season. Also show employee ID card in computer.

Hotbar and currency layout cleaned up.

🐞 Fixes and Improvements

Fixed several crashes and null reference errors.

Fixed missing materials and broken props.

Translated a lot more items behind the scenes.

Removed unused assets and settings for performance and better organization.

notes.title: Release 0.15: Comic Rendering
notes.content:
🆕 New
🌐 Gameplay Features

Squads: Characters can form squads, join together, and display squad HUD info.

Character Creation Overhaul: DNA sliders, randomization, skill selection, game mode dropdown.

Chat & Thought System: In-game character thoughts, chat logs, event notifications.

Save System: Save/load player position, skills, appearance, squad data.

Cigarette System: Cigarettes cause lung cancer; visual improvements to items.

Steam Assets & Marketing: Added Steam capsule images and game logo.

Loading Screen: New animated gear and disclaimer visuals.

🎨 Visuals & Art

Moebius Visual Pass: Crosshatching, outlines, skybox, palette, and shader optimizations.

Material Cleanup: Applied and simplified hundreds of materials for consistency.

New Assets: Angel statues, skill icons, temperature icon, faction flags.

🧪 Testing / Tooling

CI Improvements: Separate workflows, license verification, cron schedules.

Semantic Version Check: ProjectSettings now auto-tested.

Manual CI Triggering: Added ability to manually dispatch workflows.
[hr][/hr]🔧 Changes
🧩 Systems & Logic

Tasks & Activities: Improved planning logic, fixed NREs, better command tracking.

Crafting: Temporarily disabled until inventory/recipe systems are complete.

Quest Access: Can now start quests via in-game computer.

Hardcore Mode: Proper save deletion when player dies.

🖌 Visual Tweaks

Visual Style Shift: Switched to darker toon outlines, less bloom, better materials.

Moebius Shaders: Stronger outlines, cleaner hatching, improved pattern blending.

Environmental Polish: Recolored terrain, fixed emissive issues, improved skybox and lighting.

🖥 UI and UX

Main Menu Redesign: Modern look, fixed cameras, new fonts and layout.

Character Portraits: Headcam rendering improvements and frame design.

Buttons & Text: Consistent button behavior, darker backgrounds, improved readability.

Chat & Log: Messages fade, scroll correctly, and include important events and thoughts.

Misc UX: Copy/paste characters, tooltips, window pinning, skill icons, game mode info.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Fixes (Condensed)
Fixed NREs for spawning, factions, planning, and interactions.

Fixed visual glitches like missing materials, gender rendering, UI clipping.

Resolved issues with shooting logic, camera FOV, prefab overrides.

Fixed save/load issues for skills, player position, squad state.

Removed redundant assets, broken prefabs, and old materials to reduce clutter.

notes.title: Release Version 0.12
notes.content:
New

 New music
 alternative fire modes
 a rocket launcher

 basic ATM banking system to persist money between deaths

 Gravity is now 10% stronger


Fixes

 Various minor UI fixes
 Some movement fixes related to jump velocity
